note: Figures supplied by Jared (Everest) on 2 August 2026 as operational totals to date. These are no longer placeholders. Before they go in front of a funder, council, ACC or Health New Zealand, record the underlying method for each — what counts as a 'program', how unique people are de-duplicated across programs, and how retention is calculated — because that is the first thing a funding or procurement process asks for. Never round a figure upward. If a number changes, update it here rather than anywhere in the markup.

metrics.label: programmes delivered
metrics.method: Total programs delivered across app, coached and organisational offerings.

metrics.label: people supported
metrics.method: Individual clients coached directly. Counted separately from group-session reach below.

metrics.label: people reached in group sessions
metrics.method: Total attendances across group sessions. These are attendances rather than unique individuals — do not relabel this as unique people without recalculating.

metrics.label: young people engaged
metrics.method: Youth participants across EMPOWER and community delivery.

metrics.label: client retention rate
metrics.method: Proportion of clients retained. Record the measurement window and what counts as a retained client before this is used in a funding submission.
